reason: A knowledge-management plugin for exporting DSH conversations into an Obsidian-compatible Markdown vault and inspecting notes through read, search, listing, tag, and backlink tools.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH 对话导出到 Obsidian 兼容的 Markdown 知识库，并提供笔记读取、搜索、列表、标签和反向链接工具。
summaries.en: Exports DSH conversations to an Obsidian-compatible Markdown vault and provides tools to read, search, list, tag, and explore backlinks in notes.

capabilities: Reads Markdown notes and metadata from a user-specified vault
Searches, lists, tags, and resolves backlinks across vault files
Exports persisted conversations to Markdown files and updates vault indexes
Reads persisted or imported session data for export
